stories.title: Kushner meets Sisi in Egypt to discuss regional issues
stories.summary: Kushner meets Sisi in Egypt to discuss regional issues Jared Kushner and Egyptian President Sisi met in Egypt for talks on the war on Gaza and other regional issues on Sunday, according to a press release by the Egyptian Presidency.   Trump's son-in-law and envoy also held a rare meeting with Hamas' political chief, Khalil al-Hayya. Jared Kushner and Egyptian President Sisi met in Egypt for talks on the war on Gaza and other regional issues on Sunday, according to a press release by the Egyptian Presidency. Trump's son-in-law and envoy also held a rare meeting with Hamas' political chief, Khalil al-Hayya. pic.twitter.com/MJQHsFFMW7 — Middle East Eye (@MiddleEastEye) August 16, 2026
